name: Exp_ThreeCandles
summary: This EA implements the 'Three Candles' candlestick pattern strategy, identifying sequences of three consecutive bullish or bearish candles to generate trade signals. It enters long after three consecutive bullish candles and short after three consecutive bearish candles, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The system applies position sizing based on lot parameters and includes basic trade management functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了'三根蜡烛'K线形态策略，通过识别连续三根阳线或阴线的序列来产生交易信号。在连续三根阳线后做多，连续三根阴线后做空，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。系统基于手数参数进行仓位管理，并包含基本的交易管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于'三根蜡烛'K线形态识别，属于经典的价格行为交易方法。入场条件为：当出现连续三根看涨蜡烛（收盘价高于开盘价）时开多仓，当出现连续三根看跌蜡烛（收盘价低于开盘价）时开空仓。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈参数，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可以通过参数设定每笔交易的交易量。资金管理方面较为简单，没有根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整仓位的功能。该策略假设连续三根同向蜡烛代表短期动量延续，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the 'Three Candles' candlestick pattern recognition, which is a classic price action trading method. Entry conditions are: open a long position when three consecutive bullish candles appear (close higher than open), and open a short position when three consecutive bearish candles appear (close lower than open). Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit parameters, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach, where the user can set the trading volume per trade through parameters. Money management is relatively simple, lacking dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. The strategy assumes that three consecutive same-direction candles represent short-term momentum continuation, but it is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不使用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 交易时间周期，0为当前周期

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，基于经典K线形态，易于理解和验证
信号规则明确无歧义，连续三根同向蜡烛的条件客观可量化
代码结构相对简洁，便于用户进行修改和二次开发
适用于捕捉短期动量延续行情，在趋势市中表现较好
pros_en: Simple and intuitive strategy logic based on classic candlestick patterns, easy to understand and verify
Clear and unambiguous signal rules - the condition of three consecutive same-direction candles is objectively quantifiable
Relatively clean code structure, convenient for user modification and further development
Effective at capturing short-term momentum continuation moves, performs well in trending markets
cons: 缺乏市场环境过滤机制，在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动性或账户风险动态调整，资金管理粗糙
止损和止盈默认值为0，如果不手动设置则交易完全没有风险保护
三根蜡烛形态过于简单，没有结合成交量、趋势方向或其他确认指标进行过滤
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks market environment filtering mechanism, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot position sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on market volatility or account risk, resulting in crude money management
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, meaning trades have absolutely no risk protection if not manually configured
The three-candle pattern is overly simplistic without combining volume, trend direction, or other confirming indicators for filtering
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ATR），仅在主趋势方向交易以提高胜率
实现基于账户风险比例的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数方式
添加新K线检查逻辑，避免在同一根K线上重复开仓
加入震荡/趋势市场识别机制，在震荡行情中减少或暂停交易
设置止损和止盈的非零默认值，防止用户忘记配置导致无风险保护交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ATR) to only trade in the main trend direction for improved win rate
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage to replace the fixed lot approach
Add new bar check logic to prevent opening repeated positions on the same candle
Incorporate ranging/trending market identification to reduce or pause trading in sideways markets
Set non-zero default values for stop loss and take profit to prevent unprotected trading when users forget to configure

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为0，可能导致无风险保护的无限亏损
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致仓位失控
没有账户余额或最大持仓检查，极端情况下可能过度交易
简单K线形态在震荡市中会产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, potentially leading to unlimited losses without risk protection
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same candle leading to uncontrolled exposure
No account balance or maximum position check, potentially allowing overtrading in extreme conditions
Simple candlestick pattern generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
